This week is defined by two parts as well. I went to the dentist to get numerous cavities filled on Thursday. I neglected my teeth for years before and during the past 2 years, I've been seeing the dentist to get everything fixed up. The treatment left my gums pretty beat up, so I decided to increase my calories, hoping to help with the healing process. I also changed to a more liquid diet for a few days. My average daily caloric intake during the week was 1199 cal. I met my goal of consuming less than 2000 cal on the two party days.

I did very well during the week before the dentist. My mid week weigh-in came in at 181.9 lbs., after 3 days of 1400+ cal deficits. According to my logging site, I've used 7634 more cal than I ate for the week. This should translate to 2.1 lbs. of real weight lose. I appear to have the weight lose I was expecting from last week.

I went for a run twice times this week. I did a 5k for one of those runs and made a new personal record of 33:40 for 5k. I also lifted weights once this week. This was really just a practice to try out my form on the empty bar.

Failures:

* Busy week only allowed for 2 runs. * Went over cal goal one day before adjusting goal.

I'm going to start weightlifting this week. I done some reading and I plan to go with a modified version of Stronglifts 5x5. Instead of lifting weights 3 times a week, I will do twice a week. I plan to have a running day, followed by a Stronglifts day, and then a rest day. This will make me go to the gym 4 times a week. I have also been using the assisted pull-up/dips machine and can do a set of 5 of each with a 66 lbs assist. I want to get to where I can do 5 reps unassisted of each. I plan to do a set of 5 each on my running days before I run. If it interferes with my weightlifting progress, I may cut them back/out. I've also read that my diet will need to change as well. I won't be able to lift well eating 800 cal a day, so I plan to move my cal range to 1200-1800, with a strict lower limit. I got protein powder so after WL days, I can have a shake to give me a boost in protein. I also plan to get at least 100g of protein each day and will use protein shakes as needed to bump it up. My goal is over 125g of protein each day. To do this and still stay within my caloric range(since I am still want to lose some more fat), I will have to be eating much more lean meat.

The Half Mudder is now 3 months away. My goals for it are to be able to run 5 miles in an hour without feeling terrible, and to be able to perform 5 reps of pull-ups and dips. As my body fat goes down, these should become easier. I expect that some point in the future, I will have to start eating at a surplus to really put on the muscle to help with these goals.
